note: rather than editing this by hand, and read the diff when you do.
The questions are PostgREST's own, taken from the spec files that run
against its default configuration. The answers are not: upstream runs
with every transaction rolled back and with app settings this harness
does not set, so what a case is expected to answer there is not what
it answers here. recorded.json is what the pinned binary actually said.
2 requests in the spec files were not understood by the scanner and
are not here. They are the ones built out of a helper or a variable
rather than written out, and they are listed by the deriver when it runs.
